notes: 1996 two-storey police bureau. The west front (3DBAG panel 6, surface 7, 20.5 m) from the 2022 panorama (front.jpg, rectified; alternate 2021): a steel-framed grey panel and glass grid in five bays divided by red steel columns, a low dark brick plinth, a red entrance door in the third bay, and a flat red-edged roof overhang across the whole front.

Not modelled: the red columns and the full-width red roof overhang (no component for either; entrance.canopy is a single-entrance canopy and would not match), the grey spandrel panels (modelled as one curtain wall).
No striped band, blue lamp, POLITIE lettering or garage doors are visible on this front, so police components and signage are not used.
Other walls (north, east, south and the small wings) have no panorama in the cache and are left to otherWalls (blank).

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[0] system curtain-wall -> brick-bay-grid (measured punched).
